title: Randomness commitment scheme for competitive play
description: For competitive play, the server should commit to random values before they're needed (commit-reveal) to prove it didn't manipulate outcomes. How does the schema express this? Affects: dice rolls, card draws, shuffle order. The visibility model already handles hidden state; this is about provable fairness. Related to anti-cheat in P2P scenarios.
close_reason: Option A: server policy, not schema. Commit-reveal is a deployment decision (tournament vs casual). Event log hash chain provides the audit trail. Game definition is infrastructure-agnostic.
